cases.name: Mary Kathryn Pierce
cases.about: She was a barmaid at her brother-in-law's tavern, Frank's Place, in downtown Monmouth, IL.
cases.narrative: On 4/13/1966, the day she disappeared, her body was found in an empty hog house behind the tavern. She had died from a blow to her abdomen that ruptured her liver.
